# @loom/classify

Data-handling vocabulary for Loom — the sensitive()/secret()/internal() confidentiality markers + a schema walker, so a field is classified ONCE at its schema and every mechanism (crypto, redaction, egress) derives its wiring from that; plus the integrity axis (tainted()/unwrapTainted()), which attaches provenance to a VALUE at ingress because trustworthiness is not a property a schema can know. Kernel stays ignorant of both (G3).

## Entry points

- `@loom/classify`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
